title: Jade

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Jade is a material used to craft the "Nature" version of some Ashlands weapons. They have a chance to be found in the Charred chests inside Charred Fortresses located in Ashlands.
A weapon upgraded with Jade gains 10 Poison damage, and their hit effect has a 20% chance to immobilize the target for 10 seconds.

sections.heading: Crafting
sections.text:
• Klossen
• Nidhögg the Primal
• Primal Berserkir axes
• Primal Slayer
• Root Fang
• Root Ripper
• Splitnir the Primal
• Staff of the Wild

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• There is a creature (internal ID "Goblin_Gem") that never appears in the actual game, but can be spawned using the console, that drops all three kinds of Ashlands gemstones.
• In real-life, jade — particularly Type A (natural, untreated jadeite form of the mineral) — is revered for its symbolism of purity, harmony, and protection in various cultures, qualities that are inherently linked to the earth element. This could be attribute to Nature properties this material endowed to some Ashland weapons.
